risksAndRecommendations.issue: [Historical finding; current implementation has coded resolution] An empty object {} may deserialize as ClaimResult(null), so malformed missing claim field can look idle.

risksAndRecommendations.currentResolution: required claim field distinguishes explicit idle null from malformed or missing envelope; IDs bounded/nonblank, canonical UUID leaseToken and rendered payload checked

risksAndRecommendations.issue: A claim response lost after durable claim leaves SENT until expiry. A client must not interpret transport failure as proof that no delivery occurred.
risksAndRecommendations.recommendation: Keep current expiry-to-UNKNOWN and no automatic retry policy. Require hardware bridge attemptNo idempotency/reconciliation; only explicit NOT_PRINTED qualifies for ordinary retry, otherwise audited reprint with possible duplicate-paper warning.

risksAndRecommendations.issue: [Historical finding; current implementation has coded resolution] Remote acknowledge checks attemptNo presence anywhere in history, rather than verifying current/latest attempt and normalized status agreement.
risksAndRecommendations.recommendation: Validate the newest attemptNo and expected normalized result (FAILED without NOT_PRINTED becomes UNKNOWN), and match returned job/attempt status. Backend owner already fences actor, lease token and currentAttempt; do not weaken these checks.
risksAndRecommendations.currentResolution: ordered unique attempt sequences, latest attempt identity, normalized status and exact responseCode agree; FAILED->retry/PENDING duplicate receipt remains valid

risksAndRecommendations.issue: [Historical finding; current implementation has coded resolution] Non-null claim identifiers can still be blank or malformed, and leaseUntil is only checked for presence.
risksAndRecommendations.recommendation: Validate nonblank bounded job/attempt IDs and UUID token shape; consider bounded future lease checks using a supplied UTC Clock, with explicit allowed skew. DeviceNo binding is already checked.
risksAndRecommendations.currentResolution: Remote adapter does not reject past leases by local wall clock; original owner fences current attempt/token and late or duplicate receipts
